study: Run manager: does a two-phase exit (phase 1 unchanged; from +0.15% a higher-low safety net plus explicit sell signals - engine-line triangle, %R dump, into resistance, structure break, and a give-back cap only on wide runs - instead of the R-trail and decay leash) earn more per trade than the live exit, by letting profit runs continue?
registered_at: 2026-10-08 ~11:15 ET; revision 2 ~11:40 ET after the skeptic review; before the exit exists in code and before any replay of it
origin: Operator 10/8 (see the design). Design and all thresholds: docs/design/RUN_MANAGER_2026-10-08.md revision 2, part of this registration.
prior: LOW to MODERATE. Against: exits-cannot-move-the-mean (42 shapes ~0 gross); let_run_replay 10/7 FAILED (unconditional loosening worse); fills drift down on average with hold time. For: conditional holding with explicit reversal and resistance exits is untested; tight names cost ~1-3 bp.

arms.run_manager: scripts/tight_trail_replay.sh: R run_manager $NP_ON $LOB_OFF --set ai_exit_rsi_dump_enabled=false --set ai_exit_run_manager=true (design defaults)
arms.np180: R np180 $NP_ON $LOB_OFF (the live exit from 10/08 10:30), dump off - the reference
arms.s5_only: information only: phase 2 with ONLY the S5 give-back rule and the net stop (S1-S3 off) - the mechanism null

sessions: the first 12 sessions on which the run_manager build passes the per-input check (below), expected from 2026-10-12. ONE read at session 12; interim nightly numbers are direction only.
pairing: trades are matched across run_manager and np180 on (symbol, entry time within 2 s). The PRIMARY is scored on the matched set; unmatched trades (slot/re-entry divergence from longer holds) are reported per arm with their net bp, and per-day dollars per arm are reported next to per-trade bp. Phase-1 trades that differ in a matched pair are reported (expected only where a later entry was displaced).
statistic: per group (TIGHT, MOVERS): on matched pairs, run_manager net bp minus np180 net bp; per-day mean of the pair differences; mean over days with t across days (df = days - 1)
fills: exits fill at the triggering poll's price (as every variant), AND are re-scored at the next poll's price and at the price 10 s later; the pass must hold under all three fill rules
pass: per group, at the single read: matched-pair mean >= +3 bp per trade with t >= 2 across days under all three fill rules, negative on <= 20% of days, >= 60 matched pairs; AND the mechanism check: on matched pairs that reached +0.15% in BOTH arms, the paired realized-gain difference is > 0 with t >= 2 (both arms judged on the same entries; the peak over a fixed window, entry to entry + 30 min, is reported for both). A group that passes earns a live paper switch-on for THAT group only (skeptic review of the positive first). Both groups are read; no pooled pass.
fail: at the read: matched-pair mean <= -3 bp with t <= -2 in a group -> FAIL for that group; otherwise not passed -> CLOSED UNPROVEN for that group. Either closes the run-manager question for the current entry design.
labels: S5-dominated if S5 + S4 are > 70% of phase-2 exits (then the result is a give-back trail, not the holistic manager, and is reported as such). s5_only is reported next to run_manager; if s5_only passes the same bar, the S1-S3 signals are judged to add nothing.
per_input_check: every session, for every name held by run_manager: share of polls with a fresh (<= 90 s) engine read; share of phase-2 polls with >= 3 usable real (not filled) bars; share of phase-2 polls with a resistance level <= 120 s old (also reported at <= 60 s); counts of phase-2 entries and of each sell reason. A session is a BUILD FAILURE (not counted toward the 12) if phase 2 is entered on 0 trades while np180 had >= 5 trades reaching +0.15%, or if fresh engine reads are < 50% of polls, or if S1 and S3 both fire 0 times on >= 5 phase-2 trades. More than 3 build-failure sessions -> the variant is VACUOUS and not read.
information_only: sell reason distribution (S1-S6) and net bp per reason
price 15 and 30 min after each phase-2 sell
capture (realized / fixed-window peak) for matched phase-2 trades in both arms
s5_only, np_lob_slow30, np_lob_step02 and 'off' next to run_manager
unmatched trades and per-day dollars per arm
no_retuning: the design's thresholds, the arms, the fill rules, the read at 12 sessions and the bars are fixed; any change is a new pre-registration
caveats: replay recall of live buys was ~27% on 10/7: the comparison is arm vs arm inside the replay
IEX 1-minute bars are thin on some names; the higher-low uses real bars plus the engine's gap-fill rule
order-block levels are the port's (TradingView mismatch on thin premarket names, 10/7 chart check)
only trades that reach +0.15% can differ; the per-trade mean effect is bounded by that share
amended: 2026-10-08 ~11:40 ET, before any code or replay: skeptic FIX FIRST (16 findings) applied - same 30 s bar lag live and replay; peak from polled prices only; resistance via _charted_at each bar, blocks strictly above price, 120 s age; distinct engine reads by engine timestamp; S2 private cfg with the global dump off; net stop never below the inherited stop; phase-1 exits off in phase 2 listed; arms pinned; S5 only from +0.40% with a 2x-spread floor plus the s5_only null and the S5-dominated label; capture ratio dropped from the pass for a matched-pair mechanism test; trades matched on (symbol, entry time); next-poll and +10 s fills; one read at 12 sessions per group; per-input vacuity checks.
